description: 100 balanced real-world enterprise documents across 4 sensitivity classes (25 per class)

dataset_breakdown.PUBLIC: 25 docs (15 SEC 8-K press releases + 10 Enron public bulletins)
dataset_breakdown.INTERNAL: 25 docs (15 Enron workplace logistics + 10 GitLab handbook SOP procedures)
dataset_breakdown.CONFIDENTIAL: 25 docs (15 Enron commercial contracts + 10 Enron personnel/salary memos)
dataset_breakdown.RESTRICTED: 25 docs (15 cryptographic keys/API tokens/DB URIs + 10 Enron login/password emails)

key_architectural_takeaway: Pure neural SLM achieves 48% zero-shot transfer on uncurated enterprise text (vs 25% random baseline) with zero regex crutches on text. In addition, Dynamic Chunk Batching and Speculative Early-Exit deliver a 6.7x throughput increase and 88.9% compute reduction on edge hardware.
